record_title: Exact arbitrary-state completeness boundary for Hilbert C*-module localizations
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The contribution is the exact arbitrary-state completeness boundary for the compact-operator and commutative classes highlighted by Abedi--Moslehian, plus the standard-module Hilbert--Schmidt completion model and explicit infinite-support counterexamples. Standard GNS, trace-class, Hilbert--Schmidt, Riesz-representation, and pure-state ingredients are not claimed as new. The result does not classify arbitrary C*-algebras or every individual Hilbert module. Older GNS/localization literature was not exhaustively checked for an equivalent closed-range formulation.
